name: renkei
description: renkei (連携) — self-hosted identity broker for LINE. `npx renkei init` writes a ready-to-run .env, `npx renkei` starts the server, `renkei add-client` registers your app.
author: Achraf Reyani

scripts.typecheck: node --check bin/renkei.js && node --check lib/cli.js && node --check lib/env-file.js
